verdict.rationale: Cognee has a public pricing page that states the open-source engine can run locally or on your own stack "free, forever" and lists plan features such as data source integrations and code indexing. The docs also confirm the UI and pipelines can run locally for free with no account. However, the evidence shows no per-unit rates or Cognee Cloud tier prices, which a platform engineer needs to project memory costs. Missing for 10: per-unit rates (e.g., per document, node, or query), published Cloud plan prices or limits, and a hosted free-tier quota.
